audience: webshop owners who run a CCV Shop and need orders, products and customer accounts

useCases.title: Find this week's unpaid orders
useCases.text: Filter the orders by creation date and paid state. Open one order to read its customer, totals and delivery data.

useCases.title: Search products and check their stock
useCases.text: Search the products by product number, EAN or part of the name. Open one product to read its prices and stock.

useCases.title: Review customer accounts waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the customer accounts that are pending approval. Open one account to read its details.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to an order
useCases.text: Add an internal note to an order. The note is not e-mailed to the customer and does not change the order.

useCases.title: Check the invoices of the webshop
useCases.text: List the invoices of the webshop, then open one by its id.
